Responsible 

 Designing the framework and integration between multiple applications.  

 Act as the SME for SFDC on site 

 Need to be a “go to” expert as it relates to technology (vs. business/functional reqs).  

  

 
 Design SFDC solutions and form effective project plans. Add value in all stages of project work (definition, development, deployment) 

 
 
 Development on target SFDC solutions, leveraging Force.com sites and other technologies 

 
 

 

 
 Play a lead role in evaluating new SFDC technologies/- and work on implementation plans 

 
 

 

 
 Experience with .NET, Web Services and SQL development to build integrations with different applications 

 
 

 

 
 Work with business to understand the requirements and prepare the design keeping SFDC best practices in view. 

 

 6m contract, plus ext. 

 Apply today!
